Photo: Pankaj Nangia / CREIMAS for BCCI Harmanpreet and Deepti Sharma struck centuries against Zimbabwe to seal the ODI series, with Deepti also climbing in the batting, bowling and all-rounder rankings. DUBAI Former India captain Harmanpreet Kaur on Tuesday gained two places to be eighth on the latest ICC Women’s ODI rankings. However, current skipper Smriti Mandhana lost her top position to South Africa captain Laura Wolvaardt after scores of 32 and 0 in recent fixtures against Zimbabwe. In the second ODI against the African nation, Harmanpreet and all-rounder Deepti Sharma scored a century each to give their team an unassailable lead in the three-match series. Harmanpreet had stepped down from captaincy after leading the team to a second successive Asian Games gold in Japan. In the bowlers’ list too, she moved up a spot to be eighth, the ICC stated. There is also a new career-best ranking for India youngster Pratika Rawal (up seven rungs to 21st) in the list for ODI batters, while Zimbabwe trio Modester Mupachikwa (up five spots to 39th), Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano (up four slots to 47th), Beloved Biza (up 16 places to 56th) also made ground in this list. In the updated T20I rankings, Shafali Verma (third) and Mandhana (fourth) gained one spot to go up in the list of batters.
